title: Dussehra 2025: Top 3 Family-Friendly Ravan Dahan Spots In Delhi | Events News - News18
text: The festival of Dussehra holds a special place in everyone’s heart. It symbolises the triumph of good over evil, with the burning of Ravan’s effigy being the main highlight. If you’re residing in Delhi or visiting during the holidays, it’s worth knowing where the key Ravan Dahan events take place. Choosing the right venue is crucial, as a memorable Dussehra experience involves much more than just the effigy burning — the fairground rides, festivities, and delicious food also play a significant role. In this article, we’ll share the most popular spots in Delhi where you can fully enjoy Dussehra with your family and friends. The burning of Ravan at the Red Fort Grounds is considered a truly spectacular event. Every year, thousands of people gather here with their families and friends. Beyond the effigy burning, the area comes alive with vibrant lights, funfair rides, and tempting food stalls. Arriving early gives you the chance to explore the fair and enjoy various attractions before the main event. How to get there: Easily accessible via the Red Fort or Chandni Chowk Metro Stations. The celebration at Ramlila Maidan is another major attraction in Delhi. Alongside Ravan, effigies of Meghnath and Kumbhakarn are also set alight. The accompanying fair is one of the largest in the city. From thrilling rides to traditional sweets, there’s something for everyone. While the crowd can be quite large, the energy and excitement are truly something to behold. How to get there: Conveniently reached from New Delhi, Chawri Bazaar, and Chandni Chowk Metro Stations. The Ravan Dahan held at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium offers a different and more relaxed experience. Thanks to the venue’s large size, it’s easier to move around, making it ideal for those wishing to enjoy the festivities without being caught in a heavy crowd. Children can enjoy the swings and snacks, while adults take in the spectacular effigy burning in comfort. How to get there: Easily accessible via Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium Metro Station on the Violet Line. For a quieter celebration, consider visiting the Ravan Dahan events at the Dwarka Shri Ram Leela Society or Lalita Park. These venues typically see smaller crowds compared to the Red Fort Grounds or Ramlila Maidan, allowing you to enjoy the burning of the effigies and the fair in a more laid-back atmosphere with your loved ones.
